name: Katsuragi Kiyotaka
source:
In the past, Kiyotaka is a new student at the Royal London Magic Academy. Since he's adopted by [url=/c12821]Himeno[/url]'s father, his name becomes "Katsuragi Kiyotaka". Kiyotaka is a category 4 mage who specializes in Dream Seeing magic.

[spoiler]His true family name is Yoshino. It's hinted that he will become [url=/c34294]Sakura[/url]'s grandfather after marrying [url=/c12822]Ricca[/url].[/spoiler]

[spoiler]His true family name is Yoshino. It's hinted that he will become [url=/c34294]Sakura[/url]'s grandfather after marrying [url=/c12822]Ricca[/url].[/spoiler]
